construction: Separate reconstruction from the primary rendering using complex coordinates, after re-reading Chun-Fischer-Seifert arXiv:1903.06480v2 Eqs. (3)-(6), (9)-(10). It does not read input A, its script, or its output.
admissibility: m,gamma,k,T>0; kappa!=0; kstar=k-m*kappa^2/gamma^2>0; all drift eigenvalues have negative real part
stationary_covariance: Solve M*Sigma+Sigma*M^T+Q=0 numerically without importing the analytic covariance from input A.
diffusion_evaluation: D=integral_0^infinity Cov(f_t,f_0) dt, checked by a separate Wick-resolvent evaluation

cfs_convention_map.variance_rate: CFS Eq. (6) uses D=lim Var/(2t), identical to the frozen convention
